Name: Venuekit
Author: Venuekit
Punchline: Play Venue Clash – the trading card game of your favourite FFXIV venues – right in-game.
Description:
Venue Clash from venuekit.club in an in-game window: open packs, check your album and play duels without alt-tabbing.
Play Sunset Showdown in-game – the plugin rolls /random for you.
Right-click a player → "Challenge to Venue Clash" (or /clash duel) to challenge them in-game – they get a pop-up and can join with one click.

Commands: /clash · /clash duel · /clash accept · /clash settings

The in-game browser is based on Browsingway by Styr1x (GPL-3.0).
Changelog:
- "Roll in-game" now starts /random within a second while the Venuekit window is open.
- Sunset Showdown: rolls are read reliably in every client language; practice games in the plugin window roll in-game too; faster polling during a match.
- Sunset Showdown (beta): right-click a player → "Challenge to Sunset Showdown". The plugin rolls /random for you and reads the result.
- Venue Clash window, in-game challenges via right-click and /clash duel
